f.RMSRollP: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Roll Rate controller P gain
f.RMSRollD: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Roll Rate controller D gain
f.RMSPitchP: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Pitch Rate controller P gain
f.RMSPitchD: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Pitch Rate controller D gain
f.RMSYaw: LPF Root-Mean-Squared Yaw Rate controller P+D gain

f.ErrYaw: difference between measured yaw and DCM yaw estimate

f.Health: true if barometer is considered healthy

f.IntE: Internal error mask; which internal errors have been detected
f.ErrC: Internal error count; how many internal errors have been detected

f.offset: Estimated vertical position of the terrain relative to the nav filter zero datum
